To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) patients who lose 10% of initial body weight during the first month of a weight reduction program are much more likely to continue to lose weight than those who lose less; and (2) the most important single factor in determining whether a patient loses weight is the amount of time he spends talking to his physician about weight loss.
